stories.title: Labour Senedd Member wants people to prove they can care for a rabbit before owning one
stories.summary: A Welsh Labour MS has called on the Senedd to require people to complete a training course before they are allowed to own a rabbit. stories.title: Investment Zone grants set to create 79 jobs across Flintshire
stories.summary: Fifteen businesses across Flintshire have shared £898,461 in grants from the Flintshire and Wrexham Investment Zone, with the funding expected to unlock a further £1.2 million in private sector investment. stories.summary: Chester Zoo is playing a central role in an international emergency plan to save one of the world’s rarest birds, with fewer than 250 Javan green magpies believed to survive on the planet. stories.title: Public Health Wales survey reveals scale of child poverty across Wales
stories.summary: Nearly one in three children in Wales were living in poverty in 2023-24, according to Department for Work and Pensions figures cited in research published by Public Health Wales.
